{{Quote|To continue, we need one singular vision. My vision."<br />"Brother, let us share our strength. There is no need for dominance between us."<br />" Always two there are, my brother. A master, and an apprentice. And you are the apprentice.|Darth Maul and Savage Opress|<ref name="Revival" />}}
A '''raid''' was conducted by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cybloc]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] against the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].

==Prelude==
[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], a fallen [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], resurfaced in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] with the help of his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].<ref name="brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>. Maul and Opress committed various acts of violence and sabotage throughout the Outer Rim with the help of his brother. This included the [[Duel at unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|murder]] of two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Finn Ertay/Legends|Finn Ertay]] and a [[Unidentified Nikto Jedi (unidentified spaceport)|Nikto]], at a [[Unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Revival" />

==The raid==
{{Quote|Intruders! You are trespassing on InterGalactic...|LD-112, cut off by Maul's attack|<ref name="Revival" />}}
[[File:MaulImpalesSD357-Revival.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Maul impales SD-357]]
Seeking to acquire the finances, Maul and Opress infiltrated a [[Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|space station]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]<ref name="guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep501|text="Revival" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> in orbit of [[Cybloc]]. After cutting the power, the security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on patrol went into full alert, scanning the permiter for intruders; unit [[SD-357/Legends|SD-357]] scouted the south passage, where it was thrown to the floor and impaled by Maul, alerting the other droids. Maul [[Telekinesis/Legends|lifted]] the head security droid with [[The Force/Legends|the force]] while Savage lifted two others, throwing them against the wall and destroying them, which was quickly followed by the destruction of the leader droid.<ref name="Revival" />

The two discovered a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] hidden inside of a [[Credit coffer/Legends|vault]] in the main office chamber. While Opress was entranced by their new apparent wealth, Maul reminded him that it was only a means to an end in their cause: the Jedi were hunting them, and they would be forced to defend themselves. Maul sought to build an underworld backing, using the credits to hire soldiers. Maul also asserted his authority as master over Opress, citing specifically the master/apprentice format of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]. Opress had hoped that as brothers the two would abandon the traditional Sith hierarchy; angrily, he challenged Maul to combat. Maul easily overcame him and pinned him to the floor with one of his robotic legs, and the two quickly got back on terms. The two managed to escape by stealing [[Morlimur Snugg/Legends|Morlimur Snugg's]] [[ALC-9|ship]].<ref name="Revival" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|What were they? Couple of Jedi gone rogue or something?|Warehouse supervisor|<ref name="Revival" />}}
[[File:SnuggJediConference-Revival.png|thumb|right|250px|Galia and Kenobi investigate the incident]]
The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] were sent to Cybloc to investigate the strange attack. The warehouse supervisor of the station verified the identity of the assailants, albeit believing they were rogue Jedi. The supervisor explained that the two headed in the direction of the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]; Kenobi naturally connected this with the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], the headquarters of the [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] empire. Maul and Opress planned to use their wealth to sway the pirate army into joining their cause.<ref name="Revival" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid on the Cybloc transfer station appeared in the [[Revival (episode)|first episode]] of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|The Clone Wars TV series]]; on the very first scenes of the episode. Before the episode was shown, Star Wars.com release the clip of the raid on the transfer station.
